external_buyer_arrivals.causal_boundary: Only events observed at or after the CREATE/public-event local receive timestamp are included.

first_sellable.scope_note: Empirical Rust dust-execution telemetry from separate historical launches; it is a latency distribution for our execution path, not 8YCB-specific execution evidence.

limitations: The frozen all-launch stream spans 5.42 days, below the requested seven-day completeness target.
Routed inner-instruction coverage is not independently complete; source-emitted rows are replayed and 8YCB sells are added from the native ledger at block-second midpoint.
Injected 8YCB sell timing has approximately +/-500 ms uncertainty because the native index supplies block seconds, not local receive milliseconds.
Follower entries are deterministic 0.1 SOL curve replays with 125 bps Pump fees but no network fee, priority fee, tip, slippage cap, landing failure, or contention loss.
Historical flow is replayed after inserting a counterfactual follower; downstream order sizes are not re-equilibrated for that intervention.
Safe-first-sellable percentiles come from 52 separate Rust dust executions, not the 8YCB target launches.
CREATE metadata is observable simultaneous with the atomic buy, not before it.
Repeat-wallet behavior does not prove copybot ownership, coordination, or intent.
Generic controls are time-matched and transaction-decoded but are a sample of five per target, not all 220,079 CREATEs.
No prospective shadow or live landing test of the 8YCB event was performed.

generic_outcome_generalization_at_250ms.interpretation_boundary: This tests whether target-like text generalizes to generic-launch follower outcomes; it does not use target identity or post-entry flow as a feature.

metadata_host.note: Host is reported separately from content models because it is effectively an infrastructure/identity marker.

metadata_generalization.training_boundary: Models trained on earliest 50% of target-matched time groups; validation and holdout were not used for fitting.

native_pnl_decomposition.network_fee_scope_note: Closed-position fees above; V2 all reconstructed position transactions total 3.318635 SOL.

arrival_comparison.causal_boundary: Only events observed at or after the CREATE/public-event local receive timestamp are included.

causal_findings: All measurable external demand follows the atomic self-CREATE event; none can explain 8YCB's own decision.
Repeat-cohort incidence on time-matched generic controls distinguishes copy-like targeting from generic launch participation.
Removing 8YCB sells measures demand survival without creator distribution; removing recurrent early wallets measures dependence on the repeat cohort.

external_demand_survival_after_target_fi.counterfactual_note: The no-8YCB-sells replay quantifies external-demand value if creator distribution is removed; actual replay includes native-ledger target sells.

repeat_cohort.definition: Wallet bought at least five distinct 8YCB launches within 1 second of the public CREATE event; behavioral recurrence only, not proof of intent or ownership.

stream_integrity.target_sell_injection_timestamp_assumpti: block_time_second midpoint (+500 ms); collision timing is therefore approximate within +/-500 ms
